clock.gates: F1 manual clock: extent (C2 1 px; spring 2 px), pixels outside strips, progress (C1-C10)

text-origin.gates: TextField first ink x, selection colour and start, caret (decisions 12, 13)

multi-run.gates: the case verdict is every run passing: one bad run of three must fail

notCalibratedOffline.why: needs Windows hardware; the Sandbox drives IME in-process (decisions B6, D8). Only the comparators on those dumps are calibrated.

notCalibratedOffline.what: UIA keyboard focus and OS-level focus restore
notCalibratedOffline.why: UIA reports no keyboard focus in the Sandbox (decision D7), so the gates never read it; nothing to calibrate offline.

notCalibratedOffline.what: The capture hosts themselves (Windows renderer paint, Mac NSHostingView / AXDump / AlertHooks / MAC_FACT writers)
notCalibratedOffline.why: they produce the evidence the comparators read; checking them needs new captures, which this pass excludes. Mutations assume the recorded Mac side is the truth.

notCalibratedOffline.what: Case-level tolerances outside the shipped cases (bounds in the semantic gate, a non-zero firstInkTolerancePx, the dark/pressed/focused button states, scales 1.25 and 1.5)
notCalibratedOffline.why: no shipped case exercises them, so there is no real run evidence to mutate; unit tests in factory/tools/test_pair_*.py cover bounds, default button and tolerance on synthetic dumps only.

notCalibratedOffline.what: Runtime unit suites (Swift: runtime 333, host 121, bridge 51) and the consolidation driver (factory/pipeline/consolidation/run_all.py)
notCalibratedOffline.why: they are not run-evidence comparators; the driver records pair.py's exit status, which the harness does exercise.

notCalibratedOffline.what: Provenance gates (stage identity in build.json, renderer sha256, receipts)
notCalibratedOffline.why: the lean loop (decision 4) records them but no comparator reads them; earlier provenance fault controls live in factory/pipeline/paired-five-seeded-observations-actual-v4/fault-controls.json.
